Bare resumes took the greedy line through the 95% slit, the hole in kill *10, CP7, the first thin wall's gap and under the second wall into the lower lane (94.67 -> 98.05 in ~240M steps). Paid: evals every 25M on a CPU-bound box (63-69k vs 42k steps/s) and --unstuck-max 0.1 (at the 0.5 cap the late line broke, medians 27-86%; at 0.1 every eval reached the lane, medians to 98%). The last gate (measured): a rare ~300 u launch through a 190 u gap into the closed chimney above the finish - 0/2,048 random macros and 0/32 policy rollouts from the lane finish; training's ceiling sat at 98.3% for ~1.4B steps and reached 98.52% (into the chimney) in the last hour.
